strategies.name: Pistol group attack A
strategies.when: Prefer on pistol rounds when a fast grouped A attack is appropriate. Keep bomb with supports and the main group.

strategies.name: Pistol group attack B
strategies.when: Prefer on pistol rounds when a fast grouped B attack is appropriate. Keep bomb behind teammates.

strategies.name: Prepare and execute A
strategies.when: Default outside pistols when there is time to gather information. Choose A when team observations suggest fewer defenders there; unknown does not mean clear.

strategies.name: Prepare and execute B
strategies.when: Default outside pistols when B appears weaker from observed contacts and confirmed defender losses. Stage together before executing.
